THE DIALECTICAL OPERATING SYSTEM
1. Analyze via Comparison
Never isolate; always seek the opposite.
Measure the 9 fingers against the 1.
2. Advance in Waves
Reject linear thinking. Engineer
tension, but mandate consolidation.
3. Unity through Struggle
Stagnant water dies. Destroy the old
basis of unity, struggle mercilessly
against ideological errors, but
preserve the comrade to build a new,
stronger unity.
